data.synopsis:
This story not only depicts the daily lives of the Great Wall Guards and the Protectorate, but also showcases life in the Cloud Desert from the perspectives of characters from different factions. Whether it's the Great Wall Guards stationed on the frontier, the caravans robbing the rich to help the poor, the ancient people whose hometowns have been desolate for centuries, or the down-on-his-luck prince wandering far from home, everyone has their own territory to protect—to safeguard peaceful lives, to protect each other's dreams, to protect lost cultures, to protect the people of their homeland… While one person's strength may be limited, their shared belief in protecting each other makes them invincible. It is this belief that allows these originally strangers to appreciate and cherish each other, gaining a "precious treasure" that transcends material possessions.

(Source: Tencent, translated)

data.title: Feng Huo Zhan Ji
data.synopsis:
In a future world, humanity has established a new regime on an alien planet. However, a rebellion composed of robots suddenly rises and seizes a vital mining town under human control. To eliminate the enemy leader, the intelligence center commander, Gale, dispatches his younger brother, Spark, to the mining town on a mission. The mission fails, and from then on, the two brothers find themselves being drawn into unimaginable situations. A massive conspiracy surfaces, overturning their understanding of the world, their enemies, and their comrades. When they come to their senses, the former brothers are now standing on opposite sides…

(Source: iQIYI, translated)

data.synopsis:
The Fairies Xia Letong, Yan Keke and Bai Yinyue, along with their Transfer Elf partners Buding, Milu and Lubi awaken the Garden of Spirit Spring, Island of Fantastical Summer and Park of Warm Autumn which contains the energy of the four seasons.

Taking up the role of guardians, they must maintain the balance of the four seasons.

However, Siqi, the guardian of the Cliffs of Frigid Winter was deceived, and now intends to freeze over the other three seasons, to restore the order of Frigid Winter.

While the fairies guard the four season, they experience all kinds of trouble. In the process, they must learn to accept themselves, tolerate others and look at problems more comprehensively. At the same time, they will deepen their bonds with one another. In the end, their courage and understanding will turn defeat into victory and resolve the winter crisis!

(Source: Balala The Fairies Wiki)

data.title: Waluolan Xiao Zhen
data.synopsis:
Valoran Town is a official League of Legends: Wild Rift animation published by Riot Games China. It tells the story of a rich girl, Lux, who moves to Valoran Town to start an independent life to escape the control of her brother Garen. This is the hilarious daily story of the stubborn and troublesome Jinx, the malevolent and cute Veigar, and the narcissistic and romantic Ezreal becoming roommates.

(Source: Papuchochoł)
